title: Notepad
overview_capture_placeholder: Jot something down — Enter keeps it as a draft
cap_reached: You can keep {count} notes open at once. Archive one to start another.
delete_confirm_body: “{title}” and everything in it will be gone. This cannot be undone.
delete_permanently_confirm_body: “{title}” will be removed for good. This cannot be undone.
empty_subtitle: Think here first. A note can be handed to Fleet, turned into goals, or talked through with Athena when it is ready.
readonly_notice: This note has been published, so its text is locked. Fork it to keep working.
dispatch_needs_project: Pick a project first — a note is dispatched into a repository.
dispatch_needs_draft: Only a draft can be dispatched. This note has already left.
suggestion_readonly: This note has been published — its body is locked, so suggestions can only be dismissed.
ask_athena_sent: Asked Athena. Her suggestions land in this note.
execute_milestone_hint: Hands the cut to a /ship-milestone session in this repo. Results come back on their own — the ticker ingests them.
milestone_none_free: Every open milestone already has a brief.
milestone_unlink_blocked: Only a scoped note can be unlinked. Once the scope is cut this note is the record of it.
link_needs_project: Pick a project first — a milestone belongs to a repository.
ship_blocked_criteria_none: The plan has not loaded yet.
plan_cut_empty_note: Nothing in the cut yet. Decompose this brief into goals, or open Compose scope to pick what ships.
plan_shipped_notice: This milestone has shipped, so its brief is the record of what was done. Fork it to start something new.
plan_milestone_missing: This note is linked to a milestone that no longer exists. Unlink it, or restore the milestone.
runs_empty: Nothing has been run against this note yet.
